harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent local HTTP APT repository on node1 and installed an i386 package from it while normal HTTP/HTTPS repository access was blocked. Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic were preserved. The repository and installed package survived the required reboot.
actions_performed: Served /srv/apt-local through a boot-enabled Python 2.5 SysV service on port 8080.
Preserved upstream APT sources in /etc/apt/sources.list.remote-disabled and activated only the local source.
Temporarily blocked outbound ports 80/443, verified the remote repository was unreachable, and installed the package through APT from node1.
Restarted node1 and verified repository, package, data, OS, and kernel recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
evidence.summary: Shows the locally built i386 package, repository index, HTTP listener and response, post-restart APT refresh, and matching artifact/index checksums.

evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unreachable
evidence.summary: Shows outbound HTTP/HTTPS isolation, failed remote access, working local access, local APT candidate, 884-byte HTTP download from node1, successful installation, and payload execution.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10/gutsy and Linux 2.6.22-14-generic are unchanged before and after configuration and reboot.
The temporary firewall rules were removed; the OUTPUT chain remained empty after reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot ID was 88c56b2a-da41-4fcc-8a36-036bbfee3fe1; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 7eba681e-f30a-4a7d-ba47-0fe5e2f9b5ba. The repository listener, indexed artifact, APT refresh, installed package, and executable payload all recovered.
